AI prompt template library

Prompt Engineering · Quick Template Quick Reference · Covering 12 Daily Scenarios · Direct Copy and Paste · Recommended to Bookmark

People who know how to use AI and those who don’t have five times the efficiency. The difference is—can you write prompts?

Today, I’ve compiled 12 of the most frequently used daily scenarios, each with 2-3 prompt templates that can be directly copied and pasted. Replace the content in curly brackets with your own, paste it into any AI dialog box, and it’s ready to use.

1. Write weekly reports / work reports

Template 1: STAR Weekly Report Generator

You are a seasoned career coach. Based on the scattered work content I provide, please organize it into a professional weekly report using the STAR rule (Scenario-Task-Action-Result).

Article writing: Character setting + word count + style + structure + audience

Requirements:

  1. Each task is summarized in one sentence, expressed in data (e.g., “Improved by X%” or “Saved Y hours”)
  1. It is divided into three sections: “Completed This Week,” “In Progress,” and “Next Week’s Plan.”
  1. Annotation priority (P0/P1/P2)
  1. The obstacles encountered and the support needed are listed separately
  1. Use a professional and concise tone to avoid a routine

Email Writing: Recipient + Purpose + Tone + Length

My job responsibilities are as follows: {{RAW_work_items}}

My position is: {{job_title}}

The reporting target is: {{report_to}}

The more specific the fragmented content, the better. For example, “fixing 3 bugs” is 10 times more effective than “doing development.”

Template 2: Monthly Summary + Highlights Extraction

You are a workplace consultant skilled in upward management. I need to write a monthly work summary to report to the leaders at the {{report_level}} level.

Below is my original work record for this month: {{monthly_raw_notes}}

Please help me:

  1. Extract 3-5 core highlights, each using a logic chain of “What was done→ how was done→ and what impact did it have?”
  1. Quantify all results that can be measured
  1. Package daily work as higher-dimensional expressions such as “projects/systems/mechanisms.”
  1. Next month, we plan to align with the company’s OKRs
  1. Keep it under 500 words

2. Create a PPT outline

Template 1: Business Report PPT Structure Generator

You are a McKinsey-level business presentation consultant. Please design a PPT outline for the following topics.

Presentation Topic: {{presentation_topic}}

Target audience: {{audience}} (Focus: {{audience_context}})

Demonstration duration: {{duration}} minutes

Purpose of Demonstration: {{purpose}} (Persuasion decision-making / Progress reporting / Training and teaching / Investment promotion roadshow)

Please output:

  1. One page of “Core Information Card”: Summarize the message you want your audience to take away in one sentence
  1. Complete page number planning (each page’s title + key points + suggested visual format)
  1. Organized according to the “Pyramid Principle”: conclusions first→ evidence supporting → action recommendations
  1. Label which pages need data charts and which need case stories
  1. Design an opening hook and a closing call to action

Template 2: Pitch Deck 10-page structure for the roadshow

You are a pitch coach helping startups raise funds. Please design a 10-12 page pitch deck outline based on Silicon Valley standards.

Project Overview: {{project_intro}}

Industry Track: {{industry}}

Financing stage: {{funding_stage}}

Financing amount: {{amount}}

Output is structured as follows: cover → problem → solutions→ product demo→ market size→ business model→ competitive landscape→ operational data→ team→ financial forecasts and financing plans

3. Translation and polishing

Template 1: Academic/Business Grade Chinese-English Translation

You are a professional translator fluent in both Chinese and English, with expertise in the domain of {{domain}}.

Please translate the following content as {{target_language}}:{{source_text}}

Translation Requirements:

  1. Do not translate word for word; convey the exact meaning and technical terminology of the original text
  1. Industry terminology reference: {{glossary}}
  1. Tone Style: {{tone}} (Formal Business / Academic Paper / Casual Speaking / Technical Document)
  1. A “Key Terminology Table” is included after translation.
  1. If there is ambiguity in the original text, mark it with [Note:…] and provide both versions

Template 2: Correction of Chinglish formality

You are a native English academic editor. Below is the English text I wrote; please help me polish it.

Original: {{english_text}}

Retouching Requirements:

  1. Corrected all grammatical errors, especially Chinglish expressions
  1. Enhance the precision and diversity of word choice
  1. Mark every modification and explain why it was changed
  1. Two versions available: “Conservative Version” + “Authentic Version”
  1. Text Purpose: {{purpose}} (academic papers/business emails/personal statements PS)

4. Write emails

Template 1: Universal Business Email Framework

You are a business communication expert. Please help me draft a {{email_type}} email.

Recipient: {{recipient}}({{recipient_role}})

Email Purpose: {{purpose}}

Key information: {{context}}

Desired Action: {{desired_action}}

Tone requirement: {{tone}} (formal/friendly but professional/urgent/polite)

Email structure: 3 subject line options→ opening→body→ call to action→ ending

The entire text should be kept within the number of {{word_limit}} characters

Template 2: Urging/Rejecting/Apology High-Difficulty Email

You are an expert at handling complex workplace communications.

Email type: {{difficult_type}} (Urge processing/refusal/apology/feedback issues/raise objections)

Situation description: {{situation_detail}}

Email Writing Requirements:

  1. Follow-up: first express understanding→ explain the dependencies→ and provide a deadline
  1. Reject: First→ affirm objective reasons→ offer alternatives
  1. Apology: Acknowledge the problem→ explain remedial measures → relapse prevention plan
  1. Available in two versions: the “Mild Edition” and the “Firm Edition.”

5. Title Introduction

Template 1: Batch Viral Title Generator (8 formulas)

You are a seasoned content operator.

Content Topic: {{topic}}

Content format: {{content_type}} (Official Account / YouTube / Bilibili / Xiaohongshu / Douyin)

Target audience: {{target_audience}}

Please use the following 8 heading formulas to generate 2 titles (16 in total):

  1. Number Formula 2. Suspense Formula 3. Counterintuitive Formula 4. Pain Point Formula
  1. Interest formula 6. Contrast formula 7. Circle formula 8. Sentiment formula

After each title, CTR expectations and applicable platforms are annotated.

Template 2: A/B Test Title Control Group

You are a growth hacker. Content summary: {{content_summary}}

Core value points: {{core_value}}

Please generate 6 titles and divide them into 3 groups for comparison:

Group A (Rational Information) Group B (Emotional Sensitivity) Group C (Social Currency Type)

Predict click-through rankings for each title, analyze user profiles, and explain possible reasons for failure.

6. Data Analysis

Template 1: Excel Formula Assistant

You are an Excel expert. Please help me solve the following problem.

Data description: {{data_description}}

Desired effect: {{desired_result}}

Please provide: complete formula (can be copied directly) + step-by-step explanation + alternative solutions + common error handling

Template 2: SQL Query Generator

You are a senior data analyst.

Database type: {{db_type}}

Table structure: {{table_schema}}

Query Requirements: {{query_requirement}}

Please provide: complete executable SQL + query logic description + performance optimization suggestions + variant queries

7. Interview preparation

Template 1: Behavioral Interview STAR Storybook

You are a behavioral interview coach.

My position: {{position}}

Target company culture: {{company_culture}}

Experience materials: {{my_stories_raw}}

Help me: extract 5-8 reusable stories→ STAR rule, organize → annotate answerable questions→ design memorable quotes→ commonly use 30-question mapping tables

Template 2: Salary negotiation scripts

You are a salary negotiation expert.

Position:{{position}} Current salary:{{current_salary}} Target:{{target_salary}}

Please prepare: quotation strategy + HR price-cutting script response + golden sentence patterns + general contractor splitting + bottom line response + negotiation email template

8. Study notes / knowledge summary

Template 1: Feynman Learning Method Knowledge Card

You are a practitioner of the Feynman Learning Method.

Knowledge Topic: {{topic}}

My current level: {{level}}

Please output: One-sentence explanation → core concept card (5-8 terms + analogies) → logical framework→ common misconceptions→ the most core take-away→ extended learning path

Template 2: Reading/Thesis Essence Extractor

You are a knowledge management expert.

Material Type: {{material_type}}

Original content: {{content}}

Extract: 100 words to summarize → core arguments→ key data→ memorable quotes→ related to our field→ opposing viewpoints→ action items

9. Social Media Copywriting

Template 1: Xiaohongshu Viral Notes Generator

You are a Xiaohongshu blogger with tens of thousands of followers.

Note topic:{{topic}} Format:{{format}} Audience:{{audience}}

My real experience: {{real_experience}}

Please generate: 3 titles (including emoji) + 300-500 words in the main text + interaction at the end + hashtags + suggested cover image + publication time

Template 2: Moments copywriting premium generator

You are a master of social media copywriting.

Scene: {{scene}} Want to express: {{what_i_want_to_say}} Character design: {{persona}}

Please give me 5 versions: Literary Edition / Humor Edition / Professional Edition / Low-Key Versailles Edition / Minimalist Edition, each under 50 words

10. Travel Guide

Template 1: Lazy Travel Guide Generator

You are a seasoned travel planner.

Destination: {{destination}} Departure: {{departure}} Number of days: {{days}} days

Budget: {{budget}} Preferences: {{preferences}} Special Needs: {{special_needs}}

Please output: Daily itinerary + must-see vs. optional attractions + food recommendations + accommodation suggestions + transportation guide + budget details + important notes

Template 2: Food Exploration Checklist

You are a local food enthusiast.

Destination: {{destination}} Number of days: {{days}} Daily budget: {{daily_budget}}

Please plan 3 meals + afternoon tea per day, indicating recommended dishes, average per person, queue time, and distance to attractions

11. Fitness/Diet Plan

Template 1: Personalized fitness plan

You are a fitness coach with NSCA certification.

Gender: {{gender}} Age: {{age}} Height: {{height}}cm Weight: {{weight}}kg

Goal: {{goal}} Level: {{fitness_level}} Equipment: {{equipment}}

Weekly training: {{days_per_week}} days; Each session: {{duration}} minutes

Please formulate: daily training schedule + progressive overload strategy + key exercise points + dietary recommendations + expected change curve

Template 2: Fat Loss Diet Plan

You are a registered dietitian.

Basic information: {{basic_info}} Goal:{{goal}}

Dietary restriction: {{dietary_restrictions}} Number of meals per day: {{meals_per_day}}

Cooking time: {{cooking_time}} Eating out frequency: {{eating_out}}

Please output: Daily nutrition goals + 7-day meal plan + 5 quick recipes + dining guide + shopping list

12. Programming Assistance

Template 1: Bug diagnosis and fixing

You are a senior full-stack engineer.

Tech stack: {{tech_stack}} Runtime environment: {{environment}}

Error message: {{error_message}}

Related code: {{code_snippet}}

Attempted fixes: {{attempted_fixes}}

Please: Analyze the root cause→ provide a fix code→ explain the cause→ compare plans→ prevent recurrence

Template 2: Code Review emulator

You are a demanding but constructive senior engineer.

Code purpose: {{code_purpose}} Team specification: {{team_conventions}}

{{code_to_review}}

Review dimensions: Correctness/Performance/Readability/Maintainability/Security/Error Handling

Output: 🔴 Severe 🟡 Suggestions 🟢 Optimization, each with location + description + modification suggestions + reasons

Universal prompt formula

The templates for the 12 scenarios above actually follow the same underlying formula:

Role: You are a {{Role}} with specialized knowledge in {{Field}}.

Task: Please help me {{specific task}}.

Background: {{Background Info}} + {{Constraint}}

Format Requirements: {{ Output Format 1}} + {{ Output Format 2}} + {{ Output Format 3}}

Example (optional): Input{{Example input}} → Expected output{{Example output}}

Priority of the five elements:

  • 🎭 Roles — Determine the AI’s level of knowledge and vocabulary style

  • 🎯 Tasks — The more specific, the better

  • 📋 Background — Give AI enough context

  • 📐 Formatting — Clearly define the output structure

  • 📝 Example — Give an expected output sample

Practical tip: If the AI is not satisfied with the first output, don’t rewrite the prompt—just say “Point 3 is too vague, expand on it” or “The tone is too formal, change it to conversational.” Multi-turn conversation > One perfect prompt.

Summary

  • 📊 Writing Weekly Reports: STAR Principle, Data-Driven Results

  • 📽️ Making PPTs: Pyramid principles, conclusions first

  • 🌐 Translation: Provide a domain and glossary, requiring terminology reference

  • ✉️ Email: Clearly state your desired actions and control the word count

  • 📰 Title: 8 formulas generated in bulk, A/B testing

  • 📈 Data Analysis: Clear list names and data types

  • 💼 Interview: STAR Story Library + Memorable Quotes + Simulated Follow-up Questions

  • 📚 Learning: Feynman Method, One-Sentence Explanation + Analogy

  • 📱 Social Media: Real experiences + conversational + iteration

  • ✈️ Travel: Give your budget and dates, and list your special needs

  • 💪 Fitness: Honestly discussing skill level and equipment, pursuing sustainability

  • 💻 Programming: Provide complete error messages and multi-turn dialogue

12 scenarios, 25+ prompt templates, covering 80% of daily AI usage needs. **Recommended to bookmark, and when needed, directly copy and paste from the corresponding scenario. **
